judge.rationale: The candidate invents its own protocol and type names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `SessionListMessage`) instead of the exact names specified in the issue (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `ConversationListMessage`). It completely omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config flag and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code. Furthermore, it explicitly violates the acceptance criteria by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store does not implement `listFor` instead of returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error, and by allowing `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` in validation. It also logs the raw store error message on failure (risking credential leaks) and skips the required `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md` updates.
